narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no long pauses.

lily.instruct: Bubbly, dramatic young woman who changes her mind instantly, fast and theatrical.

hana.instruct: Exasperated best friend, high-pitched disbelief, talking fast.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You have brunch with your Gemini friend. Both of her.

lines.speaker: lily
lines.text: Hiking at dawn? I'm obsessed!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's Lily. Funny, curious and very fast.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She speaks four languages badly, all at the same time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She has twelve group chats open, and she runs them all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everyone says she's the best friend they ever had.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then Lily goes to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And a different Lily comes back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Same face, new jacket and totally new opinions.

lines.speaker: lily
lines.text: Hiking? Who agreed to hiking? I hate nature.

lines.speaker: hana
lines.text: You said obsessed! Four minutes ago!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Grace quietly cancels her five a.m. alarm.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So what's going on inside a Gemini?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a car with two steering wheels.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One wheel says MOOD A, the other says MOOD B.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Both are driving, and neither one has a map.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Up front, a switchboard labelled GROUP CHATS.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Twelve cables, all plugged in, all buzzing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And a coin marked DECISIONS spins forever on the dashboard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lily doesn't come hiking. She sends a voice note.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's nine minutes long and covers six topics.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hana is still listening at the top of the mountain.

lines.speaker: hana
lines.text: Wait, she's coming tomorrow? Which Lily?
